name: Creador de facturas ARCA
tagline: Sets up ARCA e-invoicing once, then mails your Factura C PDFs every month
description: Built for independent sellers in Argentina. It walks you through the one-time plumbing, linking a Gmail account, installing the tax certificate and registering a point of sale, and after that it raises each Factura C and sends the PDF out by mail without anyone opening the tax portal again.
author: tomidelu_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
